facts.system_description: An AI tool used by an employer to automatically filter and rank job applications and recommend which candidates should be invited to interview.
facts.intended_purpose: Recruitment and candidate screening for job openings.

notes: 2025-06-01: Chapter II (Article 5) is in force (since 2025-02-02); the Annex III high-risk pathway is not yet (general application date 2026-08-02) -- high_risk is NOT_APPLICABLE, deterministically, no LLM call for that category.
